Home.description: See them smile again, be moved, sing, learn —and, why not, cry too— surrounded by the people they love, in moments none of you will forget.

mission.title: One open slot in the schedule can be the best moment of the month.
mission.description: We don't replace care — we accompany it. We coordinate with each centre so music, theatre, or a workshop arrives without interrupting care, and so every performance means something to the person receiving it.

Help.title: How Todo el tiempo cuenta works
Help.intro: A quick guide to the process, for centres, artists, and families.

howItWorks.title: How a moment comes together
howItWorks.description: Four steps, one shared afternoon. Before any of it begins, an administrator validates every centre and every artist; after that, each step is reviewed before it reaches the people who'll receive it.

01.text: Open a slot in the centre's agenda — a date, a time, a place where the people there could use some company.

02.text: Browse open slots and propose an activity: music, storytelling, magic, a workshop.

03.text: The same centre reviews the proposals it received and confirms one. The moment becomes a scheduled event.

04.text: The people there and their families see what's coming up, and share how it went.

items.question: How are events and artists rated?
items.answer: Registered users can rate a published event 1–5 stars, and each event shows its average. The testimonial quotes on the homepage remain illustrative examples, not verified reviews.

items.question: What do a slot's age bands (audience) mean?
items.answer: Each slot a centre publishes shows a rough age band — for example ages 0–5, 6–12, adults, or all ages — so artists can propose an activity suited to who'll attend.

items.question: How is people's location protected?
items.answer: Todo el tiempo cuenta never publishes personal data. A slot's room or space is visible only to signed-in artists considering a proposal; it never appears in the public event listing. No one's name, exact location, or reason for their stay is recorded on the platform at all.

About.title: A non-profit platform bringing live culture to the places where care keeps people away from home.
About.intro: Here we explain what Todo el tiempo cuenta is, who takes part, how privacy is protected, and why it's free. For a step-by-step of how to publish or propose, visit Help.

purpose.title: Our purpose
purpose.description: Long stays and days away from home isolate. Todo el tiempo cuenta exists so music, theatre, and workshops reach the care centre without replacing care, always coordinated with the centre itself.

flow.title: The journey, at a glance
flow.description: A slot starts at the centre, an artist proposes for it, and it becomes a public event. For the detail of each step, see Help.

validation.title: Validated profiles
validation.description: No centre or artist can act on the platform until an admin reviews and approves their profile. That validation is what keeps Todo el tiempo cuenta safe and meaningful.

dataStance.title: What data we publish, and what we don't
dataStance.description: We publish what's needed to find a centre or an event: name, city, postal code, the centre type, and, for centres, an approximate map location.
excluded: The exact room or space where an event takes place
The content of proposals between centres and artists
Email addresses or internal database identifiers
Any visible link between a specific centre and its events
dataStance.note: The centre directory and the event listing are deliberately kept unlinked: seeing a centre never reveals which events it has had, and seeing an event never reveals which centre it happened at.

funding.title: Why it's free
funding.description: Todo el tiempo cuenta is a non-profit initiative. Centres, artists, and families pay nothing to take part; the project is sustained apart from any transaction between them.
